title: Nationwide taxi-driver protests against liability-insurance premium increase

occurrence.summary: Darik post-event account reports demonstrations in almost all Bulgarian cities.

location.summary: National report; cities described include Pleven, Burgas, Haskovo, Plovdiv region, Sofia and others.

size.summary: Darik reports tens of thousands of taxi drivers nationally; it also counts vehicles (150+ in Pleven; 1,000+ in Plovdiv region). Threshold is reported by one outlet; vehicle counts are not treated as people.

demand.summary: Drivers opposed sharp increases in mandatory liability-insurance premiums and requested return to the previous rate.

state_target.summary: The reported core demand concerns insurers; reports mention state agencies monitoring/investigating, but a precise collective state-directed policy demand is not established.

end.summary: End of national action is unclear; some Plovdiv participants said they would remain until demands were heard.

open_questions: Did participants make a specific demand to the Bulgarian state or state policy, beyond their reported demand on insurers? Can independent contemporaneous reporting substantiate the national count?
